title: Tuna niçoise bowl
summary: Tuna niçoise bowl is a mediterranean dinner built around tuna in spring water and new potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Cook tuna in spring water for Tuna niçoise bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm green beans alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss new potatoes with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Tuna niçoise bowl straight away. Taste Tuna niçoise bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
